subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should OpenClaw add WhatsApp unauthorized-group auto-leave and group-add notification as an opt-in WhatsApp plugin feature now, and what trigger and authorization contract should it use?
rationale: The source proves the requested behavior is missing, but adding auto-leave or a manual leave action changes a security boundary and introduces destructive account behavior plus new config/event surfaces.

options.title: Design Opt-In WhatsApp Contract First
options.body: Define group admission, join-event, leave authorization, and audit semantics, then implement the selected WhatsApp plugin behavior with focused tests and live WhatsApp proof.

options.title: Defer To Shared Group Pairing
options.body: Keep this linked to the broader group-pairing design and avoid a WhatsApp-specific hook until shared owner-notification semantics are settled.

options.title: Keep Allowlist-Only Posture
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw should keep dropping unauthorized WhatsApp group traffic and document manual cleanup instead of adding auto-leave behavior.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In WhatsApp Contract First
recommendation.body: Define group admission, join-event, leave authorization, and audit semantics, then implement the selected WhatsApp plugin behavior with focused tests and live WhatsApp proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current review signal and recent current-main ownership around the WhatsApp config/runtime/security boundary touched by this decision.
